name: arch-explorer
description: Build an interactive, recursively drillable architecture map of a codebase as a single self-contained HTML file — boxes are modules, labeled arrows are the interfaces between them, and every arrow expands to full signatures with source locations. Open it with a chat panel that answers questions from the code-wiki via headless Claude or Codex. Also maps what a branch changed against main, block by block, and opens that map with a chat that answers from the session that built it.
